messages:
Alicia: Quick heads-up — legal flagged a few of our example outputs as containing real-looking PII. We're rolling a v1 -> v2 deprecation + model swap next month so we need: a migration guide, sanitized example snippets, and a link audit across docs.
Ben: Ack. Do we have a scoped list of which pages/examples are affected?
Alicia: Found these via the automated crawler: /guides/chat, /examples/feedback-loop.md, and the Embeddings quickstart. I dropped a small CSV to the docs drive.
Carlos: Thanks. I can run a grep across the static site and the sample repo to catch anything missed. Will target false positives too. :mag:
Dani: We should also surface the change in the migration guide: model id rename + param rename (embed dim). Users need code snippets for TS/py and curl.
Maya: For SDK snippets, there's a breaking param rename in `Client.createEmbedding({dimension: ...})` -> `Client.embeddings.create({vector_dim: ...})` in v2. I'll draft both versions.
Josh: I'll handle wording and the de-identification rules. We should replace literal-looking names/emails with clearly synthetic tokens like <USER_NAME> and <EMAIL>. Legal prefers a short note about "sanitized for examples".
Ben: Example code to update (draft):
```js
// v1 snippet
const res = await client.models.generate({model: "redwood-v1", input: "Hello"})
// v2 snippet
const res = await client.responses.create({model: "redwood-v2", input: "Hello"})
```
Ben: Is the `responses.create` name final? want to avoid churn.
Alicia: Yes v2 is `responses.create` per the last API freeze call. We'll include a short compatibility note for teams still using v1.
Carlos: Link audit plan: run a link-checker, then PR to docs repo with fixes. I can do a pass on Monday and open PR(s) with a checklist.
Dani: Prioritize quickstart pages + any README in samples/ that are used in interviews/onboarding.
Maya: Also note quantized model aliases changed — some examples call `open-quant-7b` which will be swapped to `redwood-q-7b`. Need to update inline tables.
Josh: PR copy: "Sanitized example outputs and updated v2 migration snippets. See migration checklist in the PR body." Keep it short.
docs-bot: new link reported: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/0 -> 1234 (placeholder)
Alicia: Assignments: Josh (copy + sanitize), Maya (SDK snippet touches for py/js/ruby), Ben (smoke snippets + curl), Carlos (link audit + grep), Dani (migration guide structure + checklist). Can everyone ack?
Ben: Ack. I'll add smoke tests that run snippets against the local doc runner.
Maya: Ack. Will post branch names in the thread.
Josh: Ack. I'll push a text-only PR for the sanitize note first so legal can review quickly.
Carlos: I'll open link-fix PRs incrementally to avoid a huge change.
Dani: Timeline: aim for first PRs by EOD Wednesday, full rollout (docs redirects + callouts) by next Friday. Falls backs to rollouts if anything breaks.
Alicia: Great. One more: if any snippet includes real example keys/URIs, replace with `<REDACTED_KEY>` and add a short note on how to obtain test credentials.
Ben: Good call. I'll run a script to grep for `AKIA`/`sk_live`/`api_key` patterns too.
Maya: Branch names I'm using: `docs/sanitize-examples-1823`, `sdk/snippet-v2-1823`.
Josh: I'll coordinate with legal and tag them in the PR. @legal-team :eyes:
Alicia: Thanks all — please drop PR links here as you create them and mark the checklist in the migration guide when done. :thumbsup:
